fact: The Ministry of Justice launched the e-RCCM platform (e-actes-rccm.gov.bf) on 15 December 2025, letting users obtain RCCM registration attestations, non-bankruptcy attestations and register extracts online.

fact: Libreinfo.net reports that on 15 December 2025 the government launched the e-acte-rccm.gov.bf platform, through which extracts, registration certificates and non-bankruptcy certificates from the commerce and mobile credit register can be obtained online.
